name: Keyring generator
description: Turns what you type into a printable keyring: every letter's real outline with its counters intact, a border grown around them and bridged where it would fall apart, key rings and magnet pockets you drag into place, and a 3MF that opens in a slicer with each piece already assigned its filament.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A name becomes a keyring: the letters at their real outlines, a border grown around them, and fifteen typefaces to pick from.
The dark theme, with a second colour sent to one character. Each piece carries its filament into the 3MF, so a slicer opens it ready.
Rings dragged onto the piece itself. One pushed past the edge slides back to where it still has material around it.
Magnet pockets sunk into the back, with the base thickened to suit, beside a bank card for scale.
